title: Secretary
content: The Chief Executive Officer is responsible for: - Supervise secretary work; - Politely welcome files and correspondance;- Supervise the work of typing, inputting and updating documents;- Supervise the classification of documents;- Supervising the maintenance of mailing and receipt registers and filing;- Prepare and ensure the cleanliness of the meeting room and the General Management;- Ensure all other activities entrusted to him by the Director General
